PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-002.text: Discord server membership verification must be active and enforced at login callback.

locations.note: Discord server membership checked via getDiscordMemberStatus() at L72-80; access denied if !discordStatus.is_in_server (L96). Check is at dashboard load, NOT at auth/callback — assertion says 'login callback' which is not enforced there
Auth callback does NOT verify Discord membership — only exchanges OAuth code for session. Membership check is deferred to dashboard page.
